name: Key Replacement Execution
expected: Attack modifies target key file on disk

name: Backend Verification of Replaced Key
expected: report.ok is False and report.key_file_match is False
actual: ok=False, key_file_match=False, summary='INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED: Encrypted key file does not match the signed MHT metadata'

name: Decryption Prevention on Replaced Key
expected: Decryption is strictly blocked via IntegrityError

name: UI Metric Misleading Display Audit
expected: UI metrics must indicate key mismatch and not present 5 green/valid tiles
actual: MHT comparison=True, Modified blocks=0, Root match=True. None of 5 metrics reflects key failure!
error: UI renders 5 tiles (Manifest, Signature, MHT match, Version, Modified blocks=0), none of which reflect key file status. Stored root matches recomputed root, making user believe verification was unchanged.

name: Flip one encrypted-file byte
expected: Detected: mht_match=False, tampered_blocks>0, decryption blocked

name: Truncate encrypted file
expected: Detected: size_changed=True, ok=False, decryption blocked

name: Modify MHT metadata
expected: Detected: signature_valid=False, ok=False
actual: ok=False, signature_valid=False, summary='INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED: RSA signature verification FAILED: the MHT file or its signature was modified, or it was signed with a different key; Signed MHT file differs from the one recorded in the signed manifest for this version'

name: Re-sign MHT with attacker key
expected: Detected: attacker signature rejected under owner_pub, signature_valid=False
actual: ok=False, signature_valid=False, summary='INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED: RSA signature verification FAILED: the MHT file or its signature was modified, or it was signed with a different key; Signed MHT file differs from the one recorded in the signed manifest for this version'

name: Replace encrypted AES key file
expected: Detected: key_file_match=False, ok=False, decryption blocked

name: Unauthorized version update
expected: Rejected: manifest_valid=False (manifest signature invalid under owner public key)
actual: ok=False, manifest_valid=False, summary='INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED: Manifest signature invalid for 'attack6_unauth.txt': RSA signature verification FAILED: the MHT file or its signature was modified, or it was signed with a different key'

name: Interrupted upload
expected: PublishError raised, previous version 1 remains active and fully verifiable

name: Manifest rollback detection with min_version
expected: Receiver specifying min_version=2 rejects rolled-back manifest
actual: guarded_ok=False, summary='INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED: Rollback detected: storage offers version 1, but version 2 was seen before'

name: Manifest rollback vulnerability without min_version
expected: Manifest alone without local state or trusted timestamp should prevent silent rollback
actual: Receiver without min_version silently accepts rolled-back version 1 as active! ok=True, version=1
error: VULNERABILITY: Signed manifest lacks trusted timestamp or epoch counter; storage provider can roll back state unless client maintains stateful min_version.

name: Replay older encrypted block
expected: Replayed block produces Merkle root mismatch and blocks decryption
actual: ok=False, mht_match=False, dec_blocked=True, summary='INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED: Merkle root mismatch: 2 MHT node(s) differ; modified block(s): [0]'

name: Whole-file AES-256-GCM + Paper mode
expected: Upload, 2-leaf/3-node verification, and decryption succeed

name: Whole-file AES-256-GCM + 4096-byte blocks
expected: Upload, 4096-byte block verification, and decryption succeed

name: Per-block AES-256-GCM + 4096-byte blocks
expected: Upload, per-block verification, and decryption succeed

name: Per-block AES-256-GCM + Paper mode validation
expected: If unsupported, application/CLI must explicitly reject combination, not silently ignore
actual: block_setup_phase has no paper_mode param (False). CLI accepts --paper-mode with --block-mode and silently ignores it without error.
error: Per-block encryption does not support Paper mode (2 blocks / 3-node tree). In CLI, passing --paper-mode with --block-mode is silently ignored rather than rejected with an error.

name: Empty file (0 bytes) (0 B)
expected: Correct encrypt/verify/decrypt for Empty file (0 bytes)

name: One-byte file (1 byte) (1 B)
expected: Correct encrypt/verify/decrypt for One-byte file (1 byte)

name: Small file (500 bytes) (500 B)
expected: Correct encrypt/verify/decrypt for Small file (500 bytes)

name: Exactly 4096 bytes (4096 B)
expected: Correct encrypt/verify/decrypt for Exactly 4096 bytes

name: Exactly 4097 bytes (crosses block boundary) (4097 B)
expected: Correct encrypt/verify/decrypt for Exactly 4097 bytes (crosses block boundary)

name: Multi-block random binary (25 KB) (25000 B)
expected: Correct encrypt/verify/decrypt for Multi-block random binary (25 KB)

name: PDF file structure (70 B)
expected: Correct encrypt/verify/decrypt for PDF file structure

name: PNG Image structure (67 B)
expected: Correct encrypt/verify/decrypt for PNG Image structure

name: Special characters in filename
expected: Filename with spaces, brackets, hashes supported safely

name: Path traversal characters in filename
expected: All filenames with slashes or backslashes rejected with ValueError

name: Missing encrypted .aes file
expected: Detected safely, verification fails
actual: ok=False, summary='INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED: Version 1 files missing or unreadable: missing_parts.txt/v000001-a086a069fef5d20f/missing_parts.txt.aes not found in C:\Users\siddu\AppData\Local\Temp\ringcrypter_audit_hxoc1faa\cloud'

name: Missing files handling
expected: Safe rejection
actual: Bundle is version 1 but 'missing_parts.txt' is at version 1; build it with update_phase from the current version
error: Bundle is version 1 but 'missing_parts.txt' is at version 1; build it with update_phase from the current version

name: Corrupted manifest document
expected: Safe rejection
actual: MHT file must end with a newline
error: MHT file must end with a newline

name: Decryption with wrong Ring-LWE key
expected: Decryption fails safely

name: Dynamic whole-file update (v1 -> v2)
expected: Both versions verify, chain link verified, decrypt to respective plaintexts

name: Dynamic block-level update (partial block re-encryption)
expected: Only 1 modified block re-encrypted, 2 unchanged blocks reused, content verified

name: Stale Verification Report Persists in Session State After Attack
expected: Applying an attack should clear or invalidate stale verification session state
actual: stale_success_shown=True. User tab still displays 'Downloaded Data Verified!!! Integrity check PASSED' from before the attack!
error: VULNERABILITY / UI BUG: Applying an attack in Tab 3 does not clear ss['report'] or ss['dl']. A user switching back to Tab 2 sees the old successful verification banner and active Decrypt button until they manually click Verify again.

name: Verification Refresh and Decrypt Button Disabling
expected: Clicking Download & verify displays INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED and disables Decrypt button

name: Selectbox Target Desynchronization Between Tabs
expected: Target file in Attacker tab should synchronize with or warn user if different from User tab
actual: User tab key=None, Attacker tab key=atk_target. When multiple files exist, attacking targets a different file than user tab selection by default!
error: UI BUG: User tab selectbox has no key ('Protected files in storage') while Attacker tab uses key='atk_target'. In multi-file scenarios, attacking default file modifies a different file than the one currently selected in the User tab.

name: Directory Traversal Prevention in LocalFolderStorage
expected: _safe_key rejects any path with '..', '/', backslashes or leading slashes

name: Credential Leak Prevention in String Representations
expected: No secret keys or credentials rendered in object representations

name: AES-256-GCM Nonce Randomness & Uniqueness (Whole-File)
expected: All 12-byte nonces generated via os.urandom are unique

name: Strict Decrypt-Before-Verify Prevention
expected: decrypt_verified refuses execution unless report.ok is True and digest matches

name: Ring-LWE Key Decryption Reliability (P2 Parameter Set)
expected: 100% correct decryption rate with 2x redundancy on P2
